items.title: 5 Pipeline Stocks Built to Make Money at Any Oil Price
items.summary: Most energy investors watch oil prices and worry, but a handful of pipeline operators collect their fees whether crude crashes or surges. Five midstream names raised their payouts in 2026, and the math behind why they can keep doing it cuts against everything most income investors assume about energy.
